about: directive-reason: each honoured suppression directive needs a reason, in a form its own tool honours. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/directives.py tests/test_check_directive_reason.py tests/mutants/jpt-directive-reason-on-directives.json

mutants.name: every directive counts as reasoned
mutants.target: shell: '# shellcheck disable=SC2086' is found, unreasoned

mutants.name: a separator with no prose counts as a reason
mutants.target: js: '--' and nothing after it is not a reason

mutants.name: cppcheck's ; separator is not accepted
mutants.target: cpp: '// cppcheck-suppress arrayIndexOutOfBounds ; written past on purpose' is found, reasoned

mutants.name: phpstan's identifier form also takes -- (which phpstan drops)
mutants.target: php: '// @phpstan-ignore return.type -- returns a string on purpose' is found, unreasoned

mutants.name: a shellcheck directive is matched anywhere on the line
mutants.target: shell: the words inside a string are not a directive

mutants.name: shellcheck also takes -- (a shellcheck parse error)
mutants.target: shell: '# shellcheck disable=SC2086 -- split on purpose' is found, unreasoned

mutants.name: eslint also takes reason: (which eslint drops)
mutants.target: js: '// eslint-disable-next-line no-eval reason: a user formula' is found, unreasoned

mutants.name: cppcheck-suppress is not a directive
mutants.target: a reasonless cppcheck-suppress fails the gate
